name: @lemon/extract
description: A utility tool used to manage and understand complex systems

scripts.patch-release: npm version patch && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.patch: npm version patch && npm run release:prepare && cd dist/ && npm publish
scripts.minor: npm version minor && npm run release:prepare && cd dist/ && npm publish
scripts.release:build: npm run clean && npm run webpack && mkdir -p dist/bin && cp bin/extract.cjs dist/bin/extract.cjs && cp bin/mcp.cjs dist/bin/mcp.cjs && cp -r prisma dist/
scripts.release:prepare: npm run release:build && cd dist/ && node ../scripts/publishing/prepare.cjs
scripts.patch:dry: npm version patch && npm run release:prepare && cd dist/ && npm publish --dry-run

author: James Gibson
